name: Onion Knight's Armor

start.dialog: *layers wobble majestically* My armor... it lacks SPARKLE! Need Mire crystals! Purple ones! From the deep caves! Bring me five... no, TEN! And I shall reward you! *dignified sniff*
start.objective: Collect 10 purple Mire crystals from the deep caves

progress.dialog: *impatient rustling* Where are my crystals? My armor grows DULL!
progress.objective: Continue gathering purple crystals from the cave depths

complete.dialog: *excited jiggling* SPARKLES! My armor SHINES! I am MAGNIFICENT! Here - an Onion Shield! Layers of protection! Like me! *proud pose*

party_comments.kade: It's... a talking onion. In armor. Okay then.
party_comments.twist: It's so CUTE! Look at its little layers!

hidden_outcome: If you bring 20 crystals, Onion Boss evolves into 'Ultimate Onion' and gives you the 'Onion Knight Job Crystal'
